_comment: 森林以后的物品（flight1 / river / final 三段剧本草稿用；10-30 按合订稿 yun1.txt 更新描述）。格式同 items.json；森林已有物品沿用 items.json 的 id，不在这里重复。category = material / keepsake / quest；纪念品 keepsake_burn = 以后飞行段烧掉给的燃料，burn_note = 烧掉时晨的一句话。added = 描述是补写的。

desc.en: The hand-drawn seat map from the commuter card's sleeve. Besides the sunny seats, it notes "The third car's doors slam." One seat was scribbled out, then circled again. They picked that seat together. Waiting for the afternoon sun, they missed their stop, and the friend said next time they'd have to time it right.
desc.zh: 从通勤卡的卡套里抽出来的手绘座位图。除了能晒到太阳的位置，还写着「第三节车厢的门关得很响」。有一处座位被涂掉，又重新圈了回来。那处座位是两个人一起挑的，为了等下午的太阳，坐过了站，朋友还说下次得算准时间。

desc.en: A metal footage box. The lid label reads "South Bridge, after the flood, day seven." Below it, in Niff's writing: "Caught something really big. The shadow's a blur. Need to watch again." A new label: "You can use this to find the elephant. If you find it, come back and tell me. And write it down, okay?"
desc.zh: 金属影像盒。盒盖贴着「南桥，退水后，第七日」，下面是妮芙的笔迹：「拍到很大的动物，影子糊成一团，要再看一遍。」新标签：「你可以用这个去找大象啦。要是找到了，记得回来告诉我，一定要写下来哦。」

burn_note.zh: 晨合上盒盖时，会用手指把翘起来的标签角压平，再放进装置。
burn_note.en: Chen closes the lid, presses the curling corner of the label flat, then puts it in the converter.

desc.en: It used to hang on Niff's little boat, to tell people on shore she was back. The tag says "Given to Chen. No need to return." On the back, a tiny ship with wings about as crooked as the one parked on the bank. Niff said: "It's yours now. For keeps."
desc.zh: 原本挂在妮芙的小船上，用来告诉岸边的人自己回来了。标签写「已经送给晨，不用还」，背面画了一架小小的飞机，机翼歪得和停在岸边的那架差不多。妮芙说：「送给你啦，以后就是你的了。」

burn_note.zh: 转化以后，系铃的绳圈仍挂在那里，机身晃动时轻轻摆动。
burn_note.en: Once it's converted, the loop of string it hung from stays behind, swaying when the ship rocks.

desc.en: The label says "The river Chen visited." Niff turned it upside down right in front of Chen. No leaks. "See? Inspected by Miss Niff. Good to go."
desc.zh: 标签写「晨来过的那条河」。妮芙当着晨的面倒过来试过，没漏：「看，妮芙小姐检查过的。可以带走啦。」

burn_note.zh: 空瓶上仍贴着「晨来过的那条河」的标签。
burn_note.en: The empty bottle still has its label: "The river Chen visited."

desc.en: A footprint from the mudflat under South Bridge, rubbed onto thin paper. Chen's hand and Niff's foot are drawn beside it for scale. About the size of the sketch from the forest. Whether it's the same one is still unconfirmed.
desc.zh: 南桥桥洞泥滩上的脚印，拓在一张薄纸上。旁边画着晨的手和妮芙的脚，用来比大小。和森林里的速写差不多大，是不是同一只，还待确认。

desc.en: The little wrench from the bottom of a cup, traced by Niff. Chen copied the departure date and boat name from the guestbook onto the same sheet, took a photo with the communicator, and folded it into the map. For Milo: that person did send a letter, but the north bank mailbox was washed away.
desc.zh: 妮芙用纸描下的杯底小扳手。晨把来客册里的出发日期和船名也抄在这张纸上，用通讯器拍了照，折起来收进地图夹层。要带给弥洛：那个人寄过信，北岸邮箱后来被水冲走了。

desc.en: By an abandoned loading dock, a huge gray shape with a notch missing from its left ear. Someone beside it is coaxing it up a ramp with a long string of food. On the back, a destination and a boat number. Chen keeps it in the journal's elephant pages.
desc.zh: 废弃货台边，一团宽大的灰影，左耳边缘缺了一角。旁边的人正用一长串食物引它上坡板。背面写着目的地和船号。晨夹在日记大象那几页里。

desc.en: A small bag from the upper market. The two least broken ones are in their own paper bag, marked "For when you're fixing the ship." Keep away from the oil can.
desc.zh: 高处市集买的一小袋。最完整的两块另装一个纸袋，写着「修船的时候吃」。不能靠着油壶。

desc.en: An old-model reading head from an equipment cabinet in the old warehouse. This model was only kept on the warehouse's ground floor, which is now entirely underwater.
desc.zh: 水下仓库设备柜里找到的旧型号读取头。这种型号只存在旧仓库一层，那一层如今整个泡在水下。

desc.en: The log hanging by the sluice gate in the old warehouse. The last opening is signed by Niff. Under it, a hand-drawn diagram with "Open gate" circled: "Check again. Ting confirmed there are still people on the boat." "We can't take all the crates. Don't shut the gate again just to come back for them."
desc.zh: 水下仓库泄水门边挂着的操作记录，最后一次开启的签名是妮芙。下面压着手绘图，「开闸」被圈了起来：「再看一遍。阿汀已经确认，船上还有人。」「箱子拿不完。不要为了回来拿箱子，再把闸关上。」

desc.en: From Ting. It has both their names, what they came for, and the way back. "Follow the guide rope" is underlined. The floodgate reading is noted too.
desc.zh: 阿汀给的。写着两人的名字、这次来取什么、返回的方向。「跟着导绳走」下面划了一道。还记着水闸的刻度。

desc.en: An air tank and mask borrowed from the upper market. Niff wrote down where to return them.
desc.zh: 高处市集借的气瓶和面罩。妮芙写好了归还地点。

desc.en: An old pipe joint fished out of the river. It still turns. For the ship.
desc.zh: 从河里捞上来的旧管道接头，还能拧。修飞机用。

desc.en: A seal ring picked up on the way through the old warehouse. Soaked, but somehow not cracked. For the ship.
desc.zh: 水下仓库里顺路取回的密封圈。泡过水，反而没裂。修飞机用。

desc.en: A bag of ordinary materials from Ting, well dried. He told Chen not to mix any food in with it.
desc.zh: 阿汀送来的一袋普通材料，晾得很干。他让晨别把吃的也混在里面。

desc.en: The first page, torn from the journal and folded, kept inside the coat with the original drawing. It still says only: "I have to find the elephant, because" and then a lot of blank space. Kept through every item choice and all four endings. Not fuel. View only.
desc.zh: 从日记上拆下来的第一页，折好了，和最初那张画一起放在外套内侧。纸上仍只写着：“我一定要找到大象，因为”，后面留着大片空白。所有物品选择和四个结局里都保留，不计入燃料，只能查看。

desc.en: A few sheets borrowed from the locals after the journal burned. Today goes on these for now.
desc.zh: 日记烧掉以后，向居民借来的几张纸。今天的事先记在这上面。
